3.2.2.2.15 BswMJ1939NmIndication
Signature:
void BswM_J1939Nm_StateChangeNotification(
NetworkHandleType nmNetworkHandle,
uint8 Node,
Nm_StateType nmCurrentState
)
Modes:
modeGroup Nm_StateType
Example:
request BswMJ1939NmIndication J1939NmState {
network "Channel1"
node "Node1"
initialValue NM_STATE_UNINIT
processing IMMEDIATE
}
Note:
This ModeRequestSource has to be configured for each channel
managed by J1939 network management. This type of Mode Re-
quest Source is currently not supported by ARText.
